data.one_liner: Flutter package for rendering interactive Sankey diagrams with gradient links and d3 layout.
data.what_it_does: Provides widgets and helpers for rendering flow diagrams using the d3-sankey layout algorithm directly in Flutter. It supports gradient links, node selection, custom node widths, padding, and toggleable labels.
use_when: You need to display a Sankey diagram showing flow values and node connections.
You want interactive node selection with callbacks and HSL selection borders.
avoid_when: You need standard charts like line, bar, or pie charts instead of node-link flow diagrams.
strengths: Adapts the proven d3-sankey layout algorithm into Dart.
Supports smooth gradient links and texture overlays.
Includes responsive design support via LayoutBuilder.
weaknesses: Early version (0.0.3) with potentially evolving APIs.
